record.content: The current campground page lists 75 campsites: 12 full-hookup RV sites, one developed group site, 53 drive-up tent sites, and 10 hike-in tent sites numbered 13-22 that are explicitly not backpack sites. It publishes family and group fees, reservation lead times, gate and quiet hours, facilities, group-camp capacities, and an October 12-November 30, 2026 family-campground closure.
